notes: Reached via Chrome connector, direct navigation, HTTP 200 throughout. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Site is Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC/Demandware, 'Sites-liberty-Site'). Walked the full mega-menu under /uk/department/home/ (Home Accessories, Home Furnishings, Shop By Room, Brands) and cross-checked sitemap_5-category.xml (3570 category URLs) with a furniture-keyword regex scoped to /uk/department/home/ to catch any node the nav under-reports, per the mandatory sitemap cross-check. The regex hits were false positives from 'table' matching 'tabletop'/'tableware' (Kitchen & Dining tableware, glass-and-drinksware) except one genuine node: Home Furnishings > Footstools & Furniture. Contents: 19 OMERSA leather animal-shaped footstools/ottomans (Giraffe, Bear, Sheep, Elephant, Camel, Hippo, Dachshund, Labrador, Bull, Cockerel, Turtle, Basset Hound, Mouse - all genuine seating/ottoman furniture pieces, decorative in form but functional footstools) plus 1 Fornasetti 'Capitello Jornico Chair'. The site itself titles and files this node as 'Footstools & Furniture', satisfying the site-classification rule for ottomans/footstools. Also opened 'Shop By Room > Bedroom' (197 results, sampled 96) to verify the room roll-ups genuinely contain no additional furniture not already captured elsewhere: confirmed it is 100% textiles/candles/lamps/robes (duvets, pillowcases, cushions, throws, diffusers, an LED lamp) with zero furniture items visible - consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass's characterization of Shop By Room as a cross-category duplicate roll-up, so it was not extracted as a separate source. No Storage, Kitchen Accessories, or other department in the sitemap scan contained furniture-typed slugs. Sanity check: header count (20) matched the on-page 'X / 20 RESULTS' footer exactly (both same session read, no drift), single page with no pagination needed to reach the true end.
